text:
maria_cs: Hey team — Aurelia Labs renewal hit my queue. They want to add Dedicated for inference (1x A100 equivalent pool) and a 12mo committed pricing overlay. Procurement is asking for invoice to go through their reseller/legal entity which we've not done for this account before. need advice on PO + esign path.
sam_am: thanks Maria. are we keeping term pricing the same or moving to committed-discount? Aurelia asked for a 20% commit discount w/ usage overage. also they requested KMS integration for key isolation — that affects Private/Dedicated scoping.
leo_finance: if reseller invoice is required we need reseller tax details and a reseller invoice flow. also finance asked for net60. can someone confirm the legal entity and TAX ID?
maria_cs: they sent this snippet earlier: `Invoice to: Aurelia Labs, remit@resellerco.com, PO: AURE-2026-0912`. reseller is Resellia Inc (US EIN 12-3456789) per their procurement.
viv_legal: quick heads up — they attached a redline to the SOW that adds language around data residency for the Dedicated pool and an indemnity tweak for KMS. i can review but need the exact SOW version. if finance requires reseller invoicing we'll need the reseller addendum signed too.
rebecca_pm: flag from PM — Aurelia asked that model telemetry be limited for Dedicated (no PII collection) and they requested a short onboarding session for their infra team post-signature. can we include a 90-min enablement slot in the SOW?
sam_am: ok plan: 1) confirm reseller EIN + billing contact 2) accept net60 or push net30 (leo?) 3) accept commit discount if we tie to usage SLAs 4) slot enablement into SOW as a deliverable.
leo_finance: net60 is acceptable for enterprise renewals with reseller involved but need AP contact + remit address. send to me and i'll generate invoice terms.
maria_cs: sent AP contact via DM to @leo_finance.
docusign-bot: ERROR: Envelope 0x9f2 failed to create. Reason: signer email bounce (bounce@resellia). Retry suggested.
maria_cs: ugh — their signer is OOO until monday and the email in Proc is a distribution (bounce@resellia). procurement asked to use a wet-sign fallback if docu fails.
sam_am: let's not block. viv, can you approve the reseller addendum language? if legal signs off we can prepare a manual PDF for wet-sign and have AP route.
viv_legal: i've reviewed most redlines. two small tweaks (remove broad indemnity clause + clarify KMS SCIM scope). i can sign once those are updated.
rebecca_pm: scheduling note — if we target enablement next fri (7 days from sign) i'll block time for infra + product engineer. prefer to have SOW locked by Wed EOD.
leo_finance: confirmed — i can issue invoice to Resellia Inc with net60 once addendum signed. put `Bill-to: Resellia Inc; Remit: remit@resellia.com; PO: AURE-2026-0912` into the invoice notes.
maria_cs: thanks. I'll push updated SOW with enablement and legal tweaks now. if docusign keeps failing we'll prepare `wet-sign` PDF and instructions. tagging @sam_am for final pricing approval before SOW goes out. :thumbsup:
sam_am: approved the 20% commit discount contingent on a 9-mo ramp and a usage SLA; let's add a clause: `commit trueup quarterly`.
maria_cs: perfect. i'll send updated SOW + reseller addendum to Viv for sign, attempt docusign once more, and if it errors again switch to wet-sign per procurement. will follow up in this thread with envelope status.
rebecca_pm: captured feature feedback + enablement notes in the SOW draft. thanks everyone. :wave:
